name: Kanashi Shinsei
source: Kanashi is a 17-year old male student from Hanatani High School, who also took the role as the President of the Mystery Club. After school, he likes to take notes from his notebook, also mostly some events and news that he was very interested to look deeper and was occurred today. His dream is to save the day, but he couldn't unless he pass high school and college. One night, a mysterious guy just mysteriously arrived on Kanashi's room, telling him if he wanted to save the day, but only on the past and for the future. Once signing the contract, he signed himself as a Starpiecer, granting him the ability to travel back into the past. Kanashi was confused about it, but he only understands the "save the day" thing. That's where his great ability to time travel into any events that occur, no matter if it happened days, weeks, months or years ago. "Time will travel, from past to future", is Kanashi's main quote.
